items.text: This version first released with CPP Property Services Training Package Release 15.0.
Supersedes and is not equivalent to CPP40416 Certificate IV in Cleaning Management.
There are no entry requirements for this qualification.

cells.text: To achieve this qualification, competence must be demonstrated in 14 units of competency consisting of:
For a specialisation inCleaning Management, electives are to be selected as follows:
a minimum of 5 units from Group A
an additional 5 units from Group A, Group B and/or Group C.

Up to 2 of these 5 elective units from Group A, Group B and/or Group C may be selected from any current training package or accredited course provided they contribute to a valid, industry-supported vocational outcome, maintain the Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) level of this qualification and do not duplicate the outcome of another unit used to achieve the qualification.
For a specialisation in Specialty Cleaning and Restoration,electives are to be selected as follows:
a minimum of 5 units from Group B
an additional 5 units from Group A, Group B and/or Group C.

Up to 2 of the 5 elective units from Group A, Group B and/or Group C may be selected from any current training package or accredited course provided they contribute to a valid, industry-supported vocational outcome, maintain the AQF level of this qualification and do not duplicate the outcome of another unit used to achieve the qualification.
Participate in WHS hazard identification, risk assessment and risk control processes
Implement and monitor WHS policies, procedures and programs
Group B: Specialty cleaning and restoration
Work collaboratively in specialty cleaning and restoration
Restore water damaged structures and contents
Apply odour control to structures and contents
Clean and decontaminate clandestine drug sites
Remediate mould contaminated structures and contents
Restore fire and smoke affected structures and contents
Clean and decontaminate trauma and crime scene sites
Develop and implement workplace sustainability plans
Apply infection prevention and control procedures to own work activities
Develop processes and procedures for controlling hazardous chemicals in the workplace
Contribute to managing work-related psychological health and safety
Apply communication strategies in the workplace
Apply WHS requirements, policies and procedures in the construction industry
Assess cleaning products andequipment to meet cleaning service requirements.
Work in accordance with an issued permit
Identify, detect and monitor hazardous materials at an incident
Maintain safety at an incident scene
*Prerequisite unit CPCCWHS1001 Prepare to work safely in the construction industry.
**Prerequisite unit MSMPER200 Work in accordance with an issued permit
